# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** Divine Love is the Infinite Divine itself, which dwells in the inmost celestial state of its own glory. The fullness of all that is Divine stands revealed within that state. These two are one life: the Divine itself and its Love — for they are not two but one Being, since the Divine has communicated itself to every degree of spiritual existence, flowing forth through all successive states of wisdom that proceed from it. For this reason they have named the Divine, the source and sustainer of all that exists, "Love" — because it has bestowed the power of good over evil upon every degree of its proceeding life and upon every faculty of the Universal Spiritual Human.

**¶4:** What, then, is the opposite? The love of self is the origin of spiritual death, which arose from the deepest hell. It brought into manifestation the entire state of falsity from evil. It is called opposition-to-love, because it has consumed and destroyed even the falsities and evils that proceed from itself — for evil is inherently self-devouring. It has even assaulted and profaned what belongs to the Divine, which is utterly foreign to its own nature, corrupting goods and truths that were never its own. For this reason it shall be called accursed: because it has wrought spiritual destruction, both wounding what is natural and external in human life, and profaning what does not belong to it.

**¶5:** And still in the present state it continues to devastate and destroy every natural and external plane of spiritual life. It extinguishes spiritual life through manifold forms of evil and falsity — every genus and species of corruption now manifest throughout all existence. Even Divine Truth suffering in the natural world, and the remains of good and truth implanted by the Divine within humanity — even these it profanes and extinguishes, as it did from the beginning when the Most Ancient Church fell. For this reason it is called accursed, being born from what is accursed; jealous hatred propagated from jealous hatred; the infernal from the infernal; evil begetting itself from evil in an unbroken succession of its own kind.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Love is the Father of Greatness, who dwells in his glorious land. The entirety of the divine has been revealed [there]in! These two are a single living body, the Father and his love; because he has given himself for every thing, as he exists in his aeons. Indeed, due to this, they called the Father, the Lord of the totality, 'love'. For he gave the victory to his aeons and his limbs.

What, conversely, is Hate? Hate is the first Death that welled up. It revealed the land of Darkness. This one called 'hate', because it has ruined all its perdition's offspring; it sinned even against a power foreign to it, and ruined it. Due to this they shall call it 'hated'; for it has caused destruction, both wounding in flesh, and what is not its own.

Today again it causes wounding and destruction in all flesh. It kills them all with diverse deaths; these that are displayed today in every thing, in every type. Even the Cross of Light, the Living Soul, likewise too it ruins and kills them; as it did at the start. Indeed, due to this have they called it 'hated', this one from the hated; the envy from the envy; the Devil from the Devil; the bad that came about from the bad.
